router_training.recipe: EXP-08 v2（confirmed）：softmax-top-k 门控 k=min(K,4)（gate 层零初始化）+ 常驻 shared code（固定权重 1/(k+1)，额外码本行）+ Switch 负载均衡 alpha=0.01 + 码本数据初始化（batch 行 + N(0,0.01*std)）+ Adam lr=1e-3 × 300 步 full-batch(60) + VQ 重建 MSE
router_training.grid: K[8, 64] × preproc['raw', 'zscore'] × 3 种子 = 12 Router（K=16 省略降本，WB0 已披露）
router_training.seed_rule: crc32('exp06r|K{K}|{preproc}|{seed_idx}') % 1e6 + 20261023（prefix 改 exp06r -> 与 EXP-08 跨轮独立，披露）
router_training.implementation: 复用 WB1 exp08_metric_arbitration.py train_variant('v2') 逐字逻辑；torch 2.10；1 线程

determinism_repeat.note: 1 线程同 seed 重跑比对 final_loss/W2/codebook

difficulty_gate.rule: per-sample H_std >= 1e-3 的 Router 数 >= 2/3（即 >= 8/12）方可执行 inc/dec 课程对比

method.difficulty_primary: per-router per-sample predictive entropy H(p_i)（新 V2 Router，闸门核验后预期非退化）
method.difficulty_sensitivity: graph degree (high=easy, disclosed direction assumption; 5 non-graph entities deg=0)
method.analysis_unit: (arm, probe-init-seed) run; budget m nested within run (not independent obs); paired bootstrap CI at run level (n=12×3=36); router-level (n=12, seeds averaged) as sensitivity
method.expH_metric: pooled effective codes exp(H_bar) over curriculum prefix; util=exp(H)/K
method.probe: multinomial logistic regression; input p (K-dim, primary) / h z-scored 256-dim (sensitivity, linear h); online single-pass SGD lr=0.5 (order-sensitive, primary) / batch prefix full-batch GD E=200 lr=0.5 (subset-sensitive); 3 probe-init seeds/arm shared across arms (paired design); init N(0,0.01)
method.preproc: raw/none→raw input; zscore→per-feature dataset z-score (60-entity stats, unsupervised)
method.determinism: OMP/MKL=1; torch 1 thread; fp32 forward, f64 entropy; all rng seeded; crc32-derived probe seeds
method.h_variant_note: h = net[0] 线性输出（V2 架构无激活层，与 EXP-06 的 ReLU Hub Router 不同——Router 来源更换的自然结果，披露）

primary.rule: confirmed ⟺ gate pass ∧ d(inc−rnd)>=2pp ∧ d(inc−dec)>=2pp，运行级配对 bootstrap CI95 下界>0；refuted ⟺ gate pass ∧ 两臂 |d|<2pp ∧ CI95 覆盖 0 ∧ 无全域显著矛盾

exp06_baseline.note: EXP-06 回执记录作退化对照基准；其 delta 数值不复用为判据（指令 §1）
